</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">I am writing further to your letter of 2&nbsp;September 2024 serving notice that you wish to retire from your role as Chief Financial Officer
(&#8220;<B>CFO</B>&#8221;) of Ashtead Group plc (&#8220;<B>Ashtead</B>&#8221; or &#8220;<B>the Company</B>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">I am writing to confirm the
arrangements in relation to the treatment of your remuneration as agreed by the Remuneration Committee. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Notice period and transitional
arrangements</B>: Your <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">12-month</FONT> notice period has been running since you served notice on 2&nbsp;September 2024 and you have agreed that you will continue to provide assistance in connection with the handover
of your role and other ongoing matters until the expiry of your notice period. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Remuneration </B></P>
